title: Heterogeneous Model Comparison
research_project: Behaviour Based Network Attack Detection System using Machine Learning

ensemble_recommendation.decision_basis: Validation performance and complementary error behaviour; prediction-level complementarity should be verified when aligned validation predictions are available.

research_findings: Random Forest remains the strongest validation model by Macro F1.
XGBoost provides a distinct heterogeneous tree-learning perspective and demonstrates different class-level behaviour.
LightGBM performs substantially below RF and XGBoost in the current controlled configuration.
Infiltration remains the most important substantial-support difficult class and must receive special attention in subsequent ensemble evaluation.
Extremely rare classes must not dominate model-selection conclusions because their validation support is very small.
Accuracy alone is not sufficient for final model selection under the severe multiclass imbalance present in this dataset.
Step 37 must therefore evaluate whether heterogeneous probability fusion actually improves class-balanced performance rather than assuming ensemble superiority.
